name: Bobby Lashley
description:
From decorated amateur wrestler to dominant MMA superstar to world champion across multiple promotions, Bobby Lashley has always been regarded as one of the most dangerous forces to ever step foot into a wrestling ring — but today, he is something more. He is a man of strategy, precision, and control.

As one of the masterminds behind the Hurt Collective, Lashley doesn’t just fight for titles anymore. He fights to build an empire. And he is smart enough to know that with an army surrounding him, dressed in suits, driven by purpose, and fueled by profit, he is reshaping wrestling in his image.

Lashley still destroys in the ring — with raw strength, relentless ground-and-pound, and the kind of physical dominance few have ever matched. But there’s also the boss. He’s the brand. Every win is an investment. Every championship is leverage. Every broken opponent is just another deal closed.

Now, transported into the future, Lashley sees a world ripe for the taking. The goal is clear: it is not just about becoming world champion. That was always a given. No, no — he wants something more. He wants to build the most dominant collective in history and rule the wrestling world for eons to come.

Lashley and his collective will humble every legend in All Time Wrestling. The carnage they leave behind will be the foundation of their new empire. For business is booming… and pain… well, let’s just say it’s going to be very profitable.

abilities.name: All Mighty
abilities.description: Spend -3 [[stamina]] to add 2 All Mighty tokens. Whenever any player plays an attack [[card]], spend 1 token: on offense your target roll is -1 (easier) and you deal +1 damage; on defense your opponent's target roll is +1 (harder).

abilities.description: Trigger after a successful Hurt Lock or Spear. Hurt Lock: opponent gets one fewer kick-out roll attempt. Spear: deal an additional -3 [[health]].

name: Shelton Benjamin
description:
Shelton Benjamin is the quiet storm of professional wrestling — explosive, gifted, and respected by peers across generations. A multi-time world tag team Champion, a cornerstone of Team Angle, and one of the most athletic men to ever step into the ring, Shelton built his legacy through moments that fans never forgot — and opponents never recovered from.

His combination of speed, power, and agility made him a standout in every promotion he has been part of, from vaulting off ladders, trading suplexes in pure wrestling clinics, or innovating new ways to leave jaws on the floor, Shelton never had to say he was great — his performances did the talking.

But it was in later years that Shelton established himself a force to be reckoned with. As a founding member of the Hurt Collective, he fought not just for gold, but for something deeper. Standing beside Bobby Lashley, forming a group that was smart, calculated, and most of all, extremely dangerous.

Now, in a future where legacies are put to the ultimate test, Shelton Benjamin steps forward with one goal: capture the one prize that has eluded his entire career — the world championship. Anyone standing in his way… well, let’s just say that unfortunate soul is going to get hurt.
